title: The Hunter's Lodge Case
author: Baker Marsh
intro_narrative: Miss M Poirot hires Hercule Roger and his assistant Agatha to unravel a puzzle-will left by her late uncle at Crabtree Manor in Devonshire. The official will grants her use of the estate for a year—then gives everything to charities—daring her to find a later will or hidden fortune. A roll-top desk key bearing a grubby, oddly labeled envelope and rumors of secret repairs by Plymouth workmen point to concealment and misdirection. The chase runs from the manor’s study to Plymouth and ends with a sudden realization on the Taunton platform.

required_motive: Prove the existence and legal priority of a later will dated March 25 at 12:30 p.m., created to supersede the 11:00 a.m. will-form and defeat the charitable bequest.
